liam_arch: Quick RFC follow-up — proposal: "soft-segmentation" for private control plane. share CP, but spin ephemeral per-tenant control proxies for onboarding, cert issuance, and route programming. tradeoffs?

emma_infra: sounds interesting. do you mean we keep one global control-plane but per-tenant agents handle the heavy lifting in customer VPCs?

liam_arch: yep. global API + datastore, but when a tenant-onboard happens we materialize a tiny control proxy (k8s deployment or lambda) inside their account/VPC. proxy handles certs, watches route tables, and talks to our relay. it is short-lived — torn down when idle.

mike_net: +1 for fewer peering links. but curious about route scale — if proxies need to program dozens of route tables per tenant, how do we avoid AWS route table explosion / API rate limits?

liam_arch: two ideas: 1) prefix aggregation via per-customer NAT/ENI bridge so we only need a handful of routes, or 2) push route programming to a managed edge relay that owns forwarding and keeps per-tenant mappings in-memory.

sofia_sre: operational concerns: lifecycle automation has to be bulletproof. tear-down races today => incidents. ephemeral proxies increase churn. we need idempotent create/destroy and an async reconciliation model + strong observability.

nora_product: from product side, customers want clear SLA and audit trail for who changed network state. ephemeral proxies must publish audit logs to the customer KMS-backed sink. can we guarantee logs survive proxy teardown?

liam_arch: yes — proxies stream audit events to S3/CloudWatch with client-side HMAC and server-side encryption; we also persist minimal audit copies to our control-plane DB for correlation. design note: sensitive logs should never transit our environment in plaintext.

carol_security: threat model: spinning code in customer accounts increases blast radius. what permissions do proxies need? can we restrict to least-privilege IAM role plus a separate short-lived cert for control plane comms?

mike_net: IAM granularity could help. also consider a cross-account role with limited scope (routeTables:ReplaceRoute, Describe) and an allowlist for subnets to modify. rotate creds frequently.

liam_arch: plan is cross-account role + ephemeral certificate issued by our CA-on-customer (customer-owned CA) OR we mint a cert signed by customer KMS via CloudHSM integration. options depend on customer's SOC constraints.

sofia_sre: alerts/metrics: proxy boot latency, cert issuance failures, route apply error rate, reconcile loop duration. we should index metrics by tenant, region, and proxy instance id. also a slow-path fallback to a global relay if proxy fails.

deploy-bot: deploy:liam/soft-seg-proxy v0.1 -> staging at 2024-09-03T15:22Z :rocket:

nora_product: UX question: onboarding complexity. will customers need to create roles/policies manually or do we provide an IaC snippet and a simple click-to-authorize flow?

liam_arch: prefer automated cross-account role creation via CloudFormation stack the customer approves once. keep manual steps to a minimum. provide terraform/arm snippets too.

carol_security: one more: auditability of control decisions. if we fallback to a global relay, we must be transparent about which path served traffic and surface that in billing/latency dashboards.

mike_net: also cost aspect: spinning many small proxies adds egress and compute costs. quantify: proxy memory footprint ~200MB, ~0.02 vCPU per tenant when idle due to sleep mode? need cost model vs full dedicated VPC connectors.

liam_arch: action items: 1) prototype per-tenant proxy that programs a single ENI + route (aggregate prefixes), 2) run a small perf test with 200 tenants to measure AWS API rates, 3) draft the minimal IAM policy and CloudFormation flow, 4) create an incident playbook for proxy race conditions.

sofia_sre: I'll own the playbook + observability dash. can you add metrics and SLO targets for proxy lifetime and reconcile latency?

nora_product: I'll draft customer-facing onboarding flow and a short FAQ about tradeoffs (latency, cost, ops).

carol_security: I'll review the IAM and cert rotation plan. also want a brief code audit before GA.

liam_arch: thanks — I'll open a short spike PR and attach a design doc (will link here). tentative follow-up sync Thu 10am.

mike_net: small snippet that might be useful for the spike (ENI + route aggregation sketch):
```hcl
resource "aws_network_interface" "proxy_bridge" {
  subnet_id = var.bridge_subnet
  private_ips = [var.bridge_ip]
}

resource "aws_route" "to_proxy" {
  route_table_id = var.rt_id
  destination_cidr_block = var.aggregated_prefix
  network_interface_id = aws_network_interface.proxy_bridge.id
}
```

liam_arch: perfect. keeping it simple for the spike. we'll capture edge cases after initial data. thx everyone :thumbsup:
